stem: What is DIFFERENT about how Tasha first develops her style in the story “Tasha’s Hat” and how Jonah first developed his crochet skills in the article “Crochet Away!”?

options.label: A
options.text: Tasha develops her sense of style without meaning to, while Jonah did research to develop his crochet skills.

options.label: B
options.text: Tasha develops her sense of style from what she sees in stores, while Jonah developed his crochet skills by observing family members.

options.label: C
options.text: Tasha develops her style naturally, while Jonah developed his crochet skills after being encouraged to by others.

options.label: D
options.text: Tasha develops her style in order to achieve a bigger dream, while Jonah developed his crochet skills out of boredom.
